summary: Iteration 18 — Site-Content CMS end-to-end validation. Backend: 13/13 new pytest pass + full regression 59/59 pass. Frontend: 5 admin tabs confirmed (incl. ✎ Edit Page), 14 CMS sections rendered, Hero title-highlight round-trip works, Focus Box visibility toggle hides/shows on public, FAQ Add round-trip pushes item to public, Collection autoplay OFF → scrollLeft stable (delta=0), ON + fast → delta=199/3s. Helper texts present (1920×720 banner, 400×200 logo). Two DESIGN ISSUES found: (1) backend PUT /api/admin/site-content uses Mongo $set so PUT {} does NOT clear prior keys — contradicts the doc-comment 'Replaces the singleton'; (2) public components like WhyVisit/FAQ use saved `points`/`items` array as full override, so adding a single item via admin replaces the 6 default focus points (public shows only the new item, not 7 items). Banner image upload selector (cms-hero-banner-upload) test skipped due to timing on file-input; backend upload endpoint tested separately and passes. CMS reset to all-empty objects at end of run.

minor.issue: Implementation uses db.site_content.update_one({'id':'main'}, {'$set': doc}, upsert=True). Code-comment says 'Replaces the singleton site-content doc with the supplied JSON' but $set MERGES — sending {} leaves every previously-saved top-level key intact. Should use replace_one (preserving just id) or force frontend to always PUT the full tree with explicit empties (which it already does per code but a missing field still wouldn't be cleared).

ui_bugs.issue: Public list components use pick(content, '<key>.points/items', DEFAULTS). Once admin saves even ONE item, the fallback defaults disappear entirely. Expected flow in review request ('add point → public shows focus-point-6 as 7th point') does NOT work — only focus-point-0 appears. Admin UI starts with an EMPTY ListEditor (defaults are never pre-loaded into admin state), so admins cannot append without first re-typing all 6 defaults. Suggested fixes: (a) pre-populate admin state from defaults on first edit, or (b) public components merge admin list with defaults, or (c) relabel 'Reasons to Explore' admin list as full-replacement with a 'Reset to defaults' button.

integration_issues.issue: PUT /api/admin/site-content with {} is not a proper reset. Admin has no one-click reset button; next testing agent or admin user must send explicit empty objects for every top-level key to clear state.

rca_of_the_issue: List-editor default-loss bug RCA: EditPageTab.jsx initializes content via api.getSiteContent() which returns {} initially. ListEditor binds to content[section].points (undefined at first). When admin clicks 'Add Point', it sets points=[{...blank}] — a 1-element array. On save, PUT writes focus_box.points=[newPoint]. Public WhyVisit.jsx does `pick(content, 'focus_box.points', DEFAULT_POINTS)` — pick returns the saved value if present (truthy), so the 1-element array WINS over 6 defaults. Reproduction: admin → Edit Page → expand Focus Box → click '+ Add Point' → type icon/title/body → Save → refresh public → only 1 point visible. Mitigation options: (A) On CMS load, if content.focus_box.points is undefined/empty, hydrate admin state from DEFAULT_POINTS so the admin sees/edits all six and appending adds a 7th. (B) In WhyVisit, if points is a non-empty but shorter array, optionally merge with defaults (questionable UX). Option (A) is strongly preferred and matches user expectation in the review request.
